description: Make it again: makes one landing page again from nothing, as the page's Make it again press does: fresh research, the pages dial's step now, and the facts and words on file now. A draft stays until the new one passes its checks and then replaces it at the same address; a live page stays live and the new one comes as a version to publish. One at a time per page. It spends the owner's tokens, up to the page's makeItAgainUpToTokens from pages_read: say that price and use it only when the owner asks for the page to be made again or rebuilt. It needs an act key, and spends the owner's tokens as the chat's same tool would: say the price before you spend.

landingId.description: the page's id as pages_read lists it

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
